RESET.subject: Set up your Back to Life patient portal
RESET.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Your Back to Life patient portal is ready. For privacy, your assessment details are not included in this email.

Use the secure link below to create your password and view your information inside the portal:

[Set Up My Portal] → {{setupLink}}

If you were not expecting this message, please do not use the link and contact the clinic.

—The Back to Life Team
